SVP IT Strategy & AI Enablement — insurer.

Required emphasis:
- Enterprise IT strategy, portfolio governance, and AI enablement
- Cloud/data platform modernization for regulated insurer environments
- Reference architecture and delivery governance across business units
- FSA/actuarial credibility without burying credentials in early-career only

De-emphasize: generic agentic executive with no IT-strategy pillar signal.
briefing_text_bounded: Operator brief: Elevate insurer IT-enablement and portfolio governance pillars. FSA must appear outside early_career-only lanes.
